commands.name: list-latest-articles
commands.summary: List the newest articles across the whole site from the sitewide RSS feed (title, link, date, author, excerpt).

commands.name: list-section-articles
commands.summary: List the newest articles in a site section (e.g. gadgets, security, science) from the section RSS feed.

commands.name: list-tag-articles
commands.summary: List articles with a given tag from the tag RSS feed. Items include the full article content.

commands.name: list-author-articles
commands.summary: List the newest articles by one Ars Technica author from the author RSS feed.

commands.name: get-article
commands.summary: Fetch one article: title, description, author, publish date, body text and the link to its forum comment thread.

commands.name: get-thread-posts
commands.summary: Read the posts in a forum thread, including an article's comment thread, one page at a time. Can sort by vote score.

commands.name: list-forum-threads
commands.summary: List threads in a forum, e.g. News Discussion (article comment threads): title, url, author, latest activity.

commands.name: list-new-forum-posts
commands.summary: List forum threads with the most recent new posts, from Civis 'What's new > New posts'.
